newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Elektrowatt split to be tax-neutral-CS.
newsitem.headline: Elektrowatt split to be tax-neutral-CS.

text.p: Credit Suisse Group said the due diligence procedure for Siemens AG's purchase of Elektrowatt AG's industrial activities had been completed and the agreed purchase price of 285 Swiss francs per share was confirmed.
"The split between (Elektrowatt's) energy and industrial parts can be done in a tax-neutral way, as already announced," it said in a statement.
"The envisioned price of 285 francs per share was confirmed by the purchaser, Siemens AG. Submissions to cartel authorities by Siemens will take place in the next few days," CS said.
CS Group had said on Monday its plan to split up and sell its Elektrowatt affiliate has been officially confirmed by Swiss tax authorities and it could proceed with the transaction.
Last year CS announced plans to split the energy and industrial company into two units with its energy activities grouped into a company to be called Watt AG.
Following this step CS agreed to sell its stake in Watt to a Swiss-Germany consortium. Last December CS said Siemens would take over its stake in Electrowatt's industrial activities.
But the company in January said it was changing the split-up procedure as the result of a difference of opinion between Zurich cantonal and Swiss federal tax authorities.
